    1. apply(StreamKey, TableKey, StreamValue, TableValue)

Interface ValueJoinerWithStreamAndMappedKey<StreamKey, TableKey, StreamValue, TableValue, VOut>

Type Parameters:
StreamKey - the type of the original KStream record key
TableKey - the type of the mapped join key (the GlobalKTable lookup key)
StreamValue - the type of the first (stream) value
TableValue - the type of the second (table) value
VOut - the type of the joined result value
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface @Public public interface ValueJoinerWithStreamAndMappedKey<StreamKey, TableKey, StreamValue, TableValue, VOut>
The ValueJoinerWithStreamAndMappedKey interface for joining two values into a new value of arbitrary type, with access to both the original KStream record and the mapped join key. Used by KStream-GlobalKTable joins, where the join key is produced by a KeyValueMapper and does not necessarily equal the KStream record's key.

  • Method Details

    • apply

      VOut apply(StreamKey streamKey, TableKey mappedKey, StreamValue value1, TableValue value2)
      Return a joined value derived from mappedKey, streamKey, value1 and value2.
      Parameters:
      streamKey - the KStream record's key. Read-only.
      mappedKey - the join key produced by the KeyValueMapper (i.e. the GlobalKTable lookup key); may be null for a left-join when the mapper returns null. Read-only.
      value1 - the KStream record's value
      value2 - the matching GlobalKTable value, or null for a left-join with no match
      Returns:
      the joined value
